# XLSX preservation fixtures

These files are generated deterministically with Excelize v2.11.0 public APIs for chart, PivotTable, and data-validation examples. They contain no user data. The macro fixture uses the Excelize v2.11.0 test asset `test/vbaProject.bin` (from the upstream `github.com/xuri/excelize` project) solely to exercise pass-through preservation; this application never executes VBA. See the project license and upstream testdata for the fixture's source.
